dict.string: SoloPDF only reads PDF and e-book files. When you add a folder to your library, SoloPDF looks inside it for documents; it never reads, copies or uploads your photos. You can choose Don't Allow.
SoloPDF opens the PDFs and e-books you keep in Documents, and saves your highlights as a Markdown notes file next to each document.
SoloPDF opens the PDFs and e-books you keep on the Desktop, and saves your highlights as a Markdown notes file next to each document.
SoloPDF opens the PDFs and e-books you download, and saves your highlights as a Markdown notes file next to each document.
SoloPDF opens PDFs and e-books stored on external drives and USB sticks, for example when you add a folder from one to your library.
SoloPDF opens PDFs and e-books stored on network drives, for example when you add a folder from one to your library.
